name: tiktok-yap-editor
description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. 3.1: one gate ladder for both modes with a single exit contract, a static first frame, a hook word gate and hook variants, per-platform re-composes, an edit record that joins the cut to the post, a footage library with reconcile, a shared library with one brand resolver and no skill-root config.
